summary: FRP++ is a one-year Erasmus Mundus master's in advanced structural analysis and design using composite materials, run by the University of Minho, the University of Girona, the University of Naples, INSA Toulouse and the University of Toulouse. Erasmus Mundus scholarships cover the €9,000 fee and pay €1,400 a month, up to €25,800. The first call, the only one with these scholarships, closes on 31 January 2027.
meta_title: FRP++ 2027: Erasmus Mundus composite structures scholarship
meta_description: FRP++ covers the €9,000 fee and €1,400 a month for a one-year composite structures master's in Portugal, Spain, Italy and France. First call 31 January 2027.
covers: Erasmus Mundus scholarship: the €9,000 participation costs plus €1,400 a month, up to €25,800.
Up to 7 Erasmus Mundus scholarships a year for partner-country students such as those from Ghana and Nigeria, up to 3 for programme countries and 4 more for other regions.
Consortium scholarships: up to two of €9,000, three of €6,500 and six of €4,500, mostly in the first call.
eligibility: Applicants of any nationality in the first call.

A degree in civil, mechanical, industrial, materials, aeronautical or polymer engineering or a related field: a bachelor's of 240 ECTS, or 300 ECTS (bachelor's plus master's) for tracks that include Naples.
Final-year students can apply if they graduate before 31 July 2027.

English for applicants from non-English-speaking countries: IELTS Academic 6.5, TOEFL iBT 72 or paper 525, less than three years old. Without one you may submit a declaration, which can lower your score.
how_to_apply: Apply in the first call by 31 January 2027 at 23:59 UTC. Its form was marked as opening soon on 7 November 2026.

Upload a motivation letter of 1,500 to 3,500 characters, a Europass CV, diplomas, transcripts with grades and syllabi, English certificates, work certificates if any, two recommendation letters (through the portal) and proof of residence issued in the last 12 months.
Preselection results come by 12 March 2027, video interviews run from 15 to 26 March, and admission decisions arrive by 31 March 2027.
Second and third calls close on 11 June and 15 July 2027, without Erasmus Mundus scholarships.
watch_out: A four-year engineering bachelor's from Ghana or Nigeria normally gives the 240 ECTS needed; Naples tracks need 300.
Admitted students pay a deposit of at least €250, refunded or deducted from fees when they enrol.
The course runs from 1 October 2027 to the end of September 2028.
costs: Covered by the Erasmus Mundus scholarship
documents: Proof of residence from the last 12 months

faq.q: When is the FRP++ scholarship deadline?
faq.a: 31 January 2027 at 23:59 UTC, the first call. Only the first call gives Erasmus Mundus scholarships.

faq.q: Which engineers can apply to FRP++?
faq.a: Civil, mechanical, industrial, materials, aeronautical and polymer engineers, or related fields, with 240 ECTS (300 for Naples tracks).
One academic year (60 ECTS), from 1 October 2027.
